scorecard.name: crypto touch-sell (model vs market)
scorecard.verdict: survived - live paper via pm_quantbot (v2 risk package)
scorecard.detail: zero-drift lognormal w/ EWMA vol prices touch markets (reach $X / dip to $Y by DATE) off the coin's own history; sell YES when model is 10c+ under the market, hold to resolution. Signal locked before the one OOS pass; per-trade edge is the clean number: OOS +26.6%/staked-$ (71 trades, cluster-bootstrap 5th pct +5.6%), IS +10.6% (259 trades). v2 risk package (2026-07-30, tuned with sight of both halves - disclosed): 4%/market sizing, 7d re-entry, conditional delta-hedge in OKX perps (on only while the coin's 20d move exceeds 10% against the book; always-on hedging pays too much funding, unhedged repeats Nov-Dec 2024), drawdown brake -12%/halt -22% vs rolling 90d peak. Marked to venue prices daily: full 3.4y CAGR +30.5%, max DD -29.6% (all of it the Nov-Dec 2024 melt-up when the whole book was touch_up in a thin market); OOS window CAGR +65.3%, max DD -16.1%; trailing 12m +39.1%/-19.4%. The buy side of the same signal LOSES; only sells trade. Deeper history cannot clear 50%/yr because 2023-24 offered ~5x fewer candidates - the venue grew into this strategy, not out of it.
